_comment: Vendored transition registry for the product-launch workflow — the curated Tier-B subset (transform/opacity/filter on the two frame clip wrappers #el-<id>, no overlay DOM, no per-frame cooperation). Each type carries its GSAP template; the transitions.mjs injector stamps it onto window.__timelines["main"]. Recipes originate from the shared catalog skills/hyperframes-animation/transitions/ (css-*.md) — keep in step if those change. Token placeholders the injector substitutes: __OLD__ (#el-<from>), __NEW__ (#el-<to>), __T__ (overlap-start s), __DUR__ (this boundary's duration), __DX__/__DXIN__ (horizontal travel + incoming offset), __DY__/__DYIN__ (vertical). abm-video-bgdt adds whip-pan, flash-white, blur-slide, zoom-out and elastic-push (2026-09-30), written from the HyperFrames registry blocks whip-pan-cut, transitions-light (overexposure burn), transitions-blur (directional blur), transitions-scale (zoom out) and transitions-push (elastic push); same rule: transform, opacity and filter on the two wrappers only. Templates may use JS arithmetic on the tokens (__DUR__ * 0.5).

transitions.name: blur-crossfade
transitions.note: Default when the two frames' #root backgrounds differ a lot — the blur masks the background-color clash a plain crossfade would expose.
gsap_template: tl.to(__OLD__, { filter: "blur(10px)", scale: 1.03, opacity: 0, duration: __DUR__, ease: "power2.inOut" }, __T__);
tl.fromTo(__NEW__, { filter: "blur(10px)", scale: 0.97, opacity: 0 }, { filter: "blur(0px)", scale: 1, opacity: 1, duration: __DUR__, ease: "power2.inOut" }, __T__);

transitions.name: push-slide
transitions.note: Directional. The injector picks __DX__/__DY__ from the direction and emits the horizontal OR vertical pair (not both).
gsap_template_horizontal: tl.fromTo(__NEW__, { x: __DXIN__, opacity: 1 }, { x: 0, opacity: 1, duration: __DUR__, ease: "power3.inOut" }, __T__);
gsap_template_vertical: tl.fromTo(__NEW__, { y: __DYIN__, opacity: 1 }, { y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: __DUR__, ease: "power3.inOut" }, __T__);

transitions.name: zoom-through
gsap_template: tl.to(__OLD__, { scale: 2.5, opacity: 0, filter: "blur(8px)", duration: __DUR__, ease: "power3.in" }, __T__);
tl.fromTo(__NEW__, { scale: 0.5, opacity: 0, filter: "blur(8px)" }, { scale: 1, opacity: 1, filter: "blur(0px)", duration: __DUR__, ease: "power3.out" }, __T__);

transitions.name: squeeze
transitions.note: Old compresses to a vertical line on the left edge; new expands from the right edge. Incoming starts off (scaleX 0) so its higher-track stacking is harmless.
gsap_template: tl.to(__OLD__, { scaleX: 0, transformOrigin: "left center", duration: __DUR__, ease: "power3.inOut" }, __T__);
tl.fromTo(__NEW__, { scaleX: 0, transformOrigin: "right center", opacity: 1 }, { scaleX: 1, transformOrigin: "right center", opacity: 1, duration: __DUR__, ease: "power3.inOut" }, __T__);

transitions.name: whip-pan
transitions.note: A fast camera whip: both frames travel the full width with a motion blur that peaks mid-way. Horizontal only.
gsap_template_horizontal: tl.fromTo(__NEW__, { x: __DXIN__, opacity: 1, filter: "blur(16px)" }, { x: 0, opacity: 1, duration: __DUR__, ease: "power3.inOut" }, __T__);

transitions.name: flash-white
transitions.note: The outgoing frame burns out to white (brightness), the incoming one comes back from white. No overlay: the white is the frames' own brightness, desaturated. Every filter tween names its start: from "none" GSAP would pass through brightness(0), a black flash.
gsap_template: tl.fromTo(__OLD__, { filter: "brightness(1) saturate(1)", scale: 1 }, { filter: "brightness(8) saturate(0.3)", scale: 1.05, duration: __DUR__ * 0.5, ease: "power2.in" }, __T__);
tl.fromTo(__NEW__, { filter: "brightness(8) saturate(0.3)", opacity: 0 }, { filter: "brightness(8) saturate(0.3)", opacity: 1, duration: __DUR__ * 0.1, ease: "none" }, __T__ + __DUR__ * 0.45);

transitions.name: blur-slide
transitions.note: A short sideways slip with blur and skew: lighter than push-slide, livelier than blur-crossfade.
gsap_template: tl.to(__OLD__, { filter: "blur(12px)", skewX: -8, x: -200, opacity: 0, duration: __DUR__, ease: "power3.in" }, __T__);
tl.fromTo(__NEW__, { filter: "blur(12px)", skewX: 8, x: 200, opacity: 0 }, { filter: "blur(0px)", skewX: 0, x: 0, opacity: 1, duration: __DUR__, ease: "power3.out" }, __T__ + __DUR__ * 0.3);

transitions.name: zoom-out
transitions.note: The outgoing frame shrinks away while the incoming one settles from slightly large: a step back to the big picture.
gsap_template: tl.fromTo(__NEW__, { scale: 1.12, opacity: 0 }, { scale: 1, opacity: 1, duration: __DUR__, ease: "power2.out" }, __T__);

transitions.name: elastic-push
transitions.note: push-slide whose incoming frame lands short, swings past and settles. Horizontal only.
gsap_template_horizontal: tl.fromTo(__NEW__, { x: __DXIN__, opacity: 1 }, { x: Math.sign(__DXIN__) * 30, opacity: 1, duration: __DUR__ * 0.53, ease: "power4.out" }, __T__ + __DUR__ * 0.13);
